pages.title: Penteract Lattice
pages.text: A five-dimensional cube: its shadow in three dimensions is a nest of cubes connected corner to corner. Every face is a tesseract. Turning it in the hand, the faces fold through one another endlessly. It never stops turning.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Extending a tesseract core into a fifth dimension with a hypersphere fragment and Hopf fibration, the Tesseract Assembler built a penteract. Exotic matter held the extra dimension open.
Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I, Dimensional Singularity, E8 Lattice.
